name: The Snow Sister 2024

name: Our Little Secret 2024

name: The Piano Lesson 2024
plot: حيث ينفجر خلاف عائلي بين شقيق وشقيقته بسبب تَرِكة تتمثل في بيانو، ففيما يأمل أحدهما في بيعه، يرفض الآخر الاستغناء عنه. لتكشف المعركة المندلعة بينهما الستار عن حقائق مؤرقة حول فهم الماضي واستيعابه، وصاحب الحق في تحديد ماهية إرث العائلة.

name: Joy 2024
plot: حيث يروي Joy القصة الحقيقية والمدهشة وراء ولادة \\\"لويز جوي براون\\\" عام 1978، وهي أول طفلة أنابيب في العالم والتي فتحت معها آفاقًا جديدة، ويُسلط الضوء على الرحلة الدؤوبة التي دامت 10 سنوات لتحقيق ذلك. تُروى القصة عبر منظور \\\"جين بيردي\\\" الممرضة الشابة وأخصائية علم الأجنة التي تعاونت مع العالم \\\"روبرت إدواردز\\\" والجرّاح \\\"باتريك ستيبتو\\\" لحل لغز العُقم عبر عملهم الرائد في التلقيح الصناعي (IVF). ويحتفي الفيلم بقوة المثابرة وعجائب العلم حيث يطرح قصة هذا الثلاثي المُلهم والمُغرد خارج السرب الذي تخطّى عقبات هائلة ومعارضة كبيرة لتحقيق حلمهم، وإتاحة الفرصة لملايين من البشر بالحلم معهم بعد قيامهم بذلك.

name: Maybe Baby 2 2024
plot: نلتقي بالزوجين مرة أخرى: سيسيلي وأندرياس وابنهما ليو، وليف ومالتي وابنتهما سيل. يبلغ الطفلان الآن عامين، ولا تزال العائلتان على اتصال، لكنهما تعيشان حياة مختلفة تمامًا. أثناء الفحص الطبي، يتبين أن الطفلين لم يتم تبديلهما أبدًا. بعد أن تهدأ الصدمة، تقرر العائلتان الانتقال معًا في منزل أندرياس وسيسيلي، حتى يتمكن كلا الوالدين من التواجد مع الطفلين كل يوم. ومع ذلك، سرعان ما تصبح وجهات نظر الزوجين المختلفة جدًا حول نمط الحياة والديكور وعادات الأكل وأساليب التربية واضحة، وتكافح العائلتان للعيش تحت سقف واحد. تشعر سيسيلي بارتباط أكبر بابنتها البيولوجية سيل من ليو، وتقرر السعي للحصول على حضانة سيل خلف ظهور الوالدين الثلاثة الآخرين. تدرك سيسيلي أنها تصرفت بشكل خاطئ، لكن الأوان قد فات، وينكشف مشروعها الأناني. ينهار المجتمع، وتنتقل ليف ومالتي بعيدًا مع سيل، ويجب على سيسيلي الآن النضال من أجل الحصول على المغفرة وإيجاد حل يمكن للجميع العيش معه.

name: Nayanthara- Beyond the Fairy Tale 2024

plot: A woman is released from prison after serving a sentence for a violent crime and re-enters a society that refuses to forgive her past.

name: The Turning Point
plot: As young dancers, they were best friends and fierce rivals. Deedee left the stage for marriage and motherhood, while Emma would become an international ballet icon. But when Deedee's teenage daughter is invited to join Emma's dance company and begins an affair with a young Russian star, the two women are forced to confront the choices they've made, the resentments they've hidden and the emotional truths they must face at the turning point.

name: The Trip 2021
plot: In this honest and deeply personal account of living with addiction, a young man talks about the realities and challenges of living in the Anishinaabe community of Kitcisakik and the hope he still harbours for himself and his people.

name: The Trial of the Chicago 7
plot: What was supposed to be a peaceful protest turned into a violent clash with the police. What followed was one of the most notorious trials in history.

name: The Takedown
plot: Ousmane Diakité and François Monge are two cops with very different styles, backgrounds and careers. The unlikely pair are reunited once again for a new investigation that takes them across France. What seemed to be a simple drug deal turns out to be a much bigger criminal case wrapped in danger and unexpected comedy.

name: The Summit Of The Gods 2021
plot: A photojournalist’s obsessive quest for the truth about the first expedition to Mt. Everest leads him to search for an esteemed climber who went missing.

name: The Sleepover
plot: Two siblings who discover their seemingly normal mom is a former thief in witness protection. Mom is forced to pull one last job, and the kids team up to rescue her over the course of an action-packed night.

name: The Silence of the Marsh
plot: A successful, cold-blooded crime novelist gets involved in a kidnapping case while uncovering the corrupt ties between politicians and the local mafia in Valencia, Spain.

name: The Shadow In My Eye
plot: On March 21st, 1945, the British Royal Air Force set out on a mission to bomb Gestapo's headquarters in Copenhagen. The raid had fatal consequences as some of the bombers accidentally targeted a school and more than 120 people were killed, 86 of whom were children.

name: The Seven Deadly Sins Cursed By Light 2021
plot: With the help of the "Dragon Sin of Wrath" Meliodas and the worst rebels in history, the Seven Deadly Sins, the "Holy War", in which four races, including Humans, Goddesses, Fairies and Giants fought against the Demons, is finally over. At the cost of the "Lion Sin of Pride" Escanor's life, the Demon King was defeated and the world regained peace. After that, each of the Sins take their own path.

name: The Main Event
plot: After discovering a magical mask, an 11-year-old aspiring wrestler enters a competition to become the next WWE superstar by using special powers from a magical mask.

name: The Lovebirds
plot: A couple experiences a defining moment in their relationship when they are unintentionally embroiled in a murder mystery. As their journey to clear their names takes them from one extreme – and hilarious - circumstance to the next, they must figure out how they, and their relationship, can survive the night.

name: The Half of It
plot: Shy, straight-A student Ellie is hired by sweet but inarticulate jock Paul, who needs help wooing the most popular girl in school. But their new and unlikely friendship gets tricky when Ellie discovers she has feelings for the same girl.

name: The Guilty 2021
plot: A demoted police officer assigned to a call dispatch desk is conflicted when he receives an emergency phone call from a kidnapped woman.

name: The Guide to the Perfect Family
plot: A couple in Québec deals with the pitfalls, pressure and high expectations of raising kids in a society obsessed with success and social media image.

name: The Girl on the Train 2021
plot: Rachel Watson, devastated by her recent divorce, spends her daily commute fantasizing about the seemingly perfect couple who live in a house that her train passes every day, until one morning she sees something shocking happen there and becomes entangled in the mystery that unfolds.

name: The Forty Year Old Version
plot: Desperate for a breakthrough as she nears the big 4-0, struggling New York City playwright Radha finds inspiration by reinventing herself as a rapper.

name: The Disciple
plot: Self-doubt, sacrifice and struggle converge into an existential crisis for a devoted classical vocalist as the mastery he strives for remains elusive.

name: The Dig
plot: As WWII looms, a wealthy widow hires an amateur archaeologist to excavate the burial mounds on her estate. When they make a historic discovery, the echoes of Britain's past resonate in the face of its uncertain future‎.

name: The Devil All the Time
plot: In Knockemstiff, Ohio and its neighboring backwoods, sinister characters converge around young Arvin Russell as he fights the evil forces that threaten him and his family.

name: The Decline
plot: Anticipating a disaster, Antoine, a father, attends a survivalist training given by Alain in his autonomous hideout. In fear of a natural, economic or social crisis, the group trains to face the different possible apocalyptic scenarios. But the disaster they will experience will not be the one they predicted.

name: The Day of the Lord
plot: In this horror movie, a retired priest haunted by his sins is pulled back into the darkness when a friend begs him to help his possessed daughter.

name: The Hall: Honoring the Greats of Stand-Up
plot: In this comedy special, Jon Stewart, John Mulaney, Chelsea Handler and Dave Chappelle honor George Carlin, Joan Rivers, Robin Williams and Richard Pryor.

name: The Harder They Fall 2021
plot: Gunning for revenge, outlaw Nat Love saddles up with his gang to take down enemy Rufus Buck, a ruthless crime boss who just got sprung from prison.
